texts.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

We sense we are not alone. A Sorrowed Entity encroaches upon our minds, settling a storm of psionic energy around us.

A deep sense of regret and longing are pushed into our collective psyche. We see images of familiar star systems thousands of years in the past.

Whatever this entity is, it seems to know our galaxy well. Did it once belong here?

texts.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中具有力量的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为悲伤之物。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Sorrowed Entity.

texts.zh:
这个被称为悲伤之物的遥远的力量从虚境深处里用痛苦折磨着我们的思想。它沉默无声，给了我们一个无言的警告：

在这些灵域中要小心行事。你根本不知道正在干涉的是什么力量。毁灭只有一步之遥……
texts.en:
The distant power known as Sorrowed Entity seared our minds with anguish from deep within the Shroud. It did not speak, yet its warning was unmistakable:

Tread lightly in these realms. You know not what powers you disturb. Ruin is but a step away...

texts.zh: 我们认出了这个实体。祂是我们在星界裂隙那边遇到的先知。这就是她的命运吗？她就是现在的位面之外客吗？
texts.en: We recognize this being. It is the Far-Seer we encountered beyond an Astral Rift. Is this the fate that has become of them? Are they now the Outsider?

texts.zh:
这个实体对我们的星系并不陌生。它有我们之前遇到的泽珞族文明的独特的精神足迹。但这怎么可能呢？

不管这意味着什么，位面之外客已经为我们所知。我们的命运将如何交织在一起还有待见证。
texts.en:
This entity is no stranger to our galaxy. It has the distinct mental footprint of the Zroni civilization we have encountered before. How could this be possible?

Whatever this means, the Outsider is known to us now. How our fates are linked remains to be seen.

texts.en: Whatever this means, the Outsider is known to us now. How our fates are linked remains to be seen.

label.zh: 我们可别屈从相同的命运。
label.en: Let us not succumb to the same fate.

# 位面之外客 / Outsider

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt` · `events/shroud_events.txt` · `common/inline_scripts/shroud/minor_patron_first_contact_end_event.txt` · `common/patrons/patron_types.txt`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 次要赞助者“位面之外客”的首次接触事件“虚境中的低语”（shroud.4060），由代码在虚境中自然发现时触发（common/patrons/patron_types.txt:1402），或经“虚境触及者”选项触发（须已接触全部主要赞助者）。  
  First-contact event "Whispers in the Shroud" (shroud.4060) of the minor patron "Outsider", launched by the game on natural discovery in the Shroud (common/patrons/patron_types.txt:1402) or by the Shroud-touched option (all major patrons must be contacted first).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- shroud.4060：单一选项“尝试沟通”按帝国类型启用机械版/蜂巢版/基础版接触项目（events/shroud_events.txt:8699，inline脚本minor_patron_first_contact_start_event）。  
  shroud.4060: the single option enables the robot / hive / base contact project by empire type (events/shroud_events.txt:8699, inline script minor_patron_first_contact_start_event).
- 项目成本5000（社会科技），无时限，完成后触发shroud.4065。  
  The project costs 5000 (society technology), has no time limit and fires shroud.4065 on completion.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- shroud.4065仅一个选项，把接触状态记为completed，并获得每月佐罗(Zro)产出。  
  shroud.4065 has a single option that sets the first-contact state to completed and grants monthly Zro output.
- 三个项目版本互斥，仅由帝国类型决定。  
  The three project versions are mutually exclusive and depend only on empire type.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无其他差异。  
  No other variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已对照common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt、events/shroud_events.txt与inline脚本minor_patron_first_contact_start/end_event。  
  Compared %s, %s and the minor_patron_first_contact_start/end_event inline scripts.
- 合并：原有的_HIVE与_ROBOT故事是同一接触项目的帝国类型版本，现并入本故事。  
  Merged: the former _HIVE and _ROBOT stories are the empire-type versions of the same contact project and are now part of this one story.
- 以起始事件为根并添加审阅连接。 项目标题使用游戏内的“未接触前代号”（如“Fathomless Being”），本故事标题使用赞助者名称。  
  The start event is the root, with reviewed bridges. Project titles use the in-game pre-contact code names (e.g. Fathomless Being); the story title uses the patron name.
